description.en: A one-plugin index for dsh-fast-mode. Add this URL as an index source in Plugins → Discover.
description.zh: dsh-fast-mode 的单插件索引。在「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」里添加这个地址即可。

description.en: Per-conversation fast mode for multi-step tasks: batches independent tool calls and drops redundant steps. Pooled over 9 blocks and 132 valid pairs (10 task families): total wall clock about 18% faster (0.825x, per-cell median 0.813x, 95% CI 0.747-0.914). On shapes it fits: codeimpl 0.663x (13/15 pairs faster), shellpipeline 0.749x; debugfix 1.032x and perfrefactor 1.009x are where it does not pay for itself.
description.zh: 单会话开关的快速模式：合并可并行的工具调用、减少冗余步骤。9 块 132 对有效配对的合池结果：整任务总墙钟约快 18 %（0.825×，逐格中位 0.813×，95% 区间 0.747–0.914）；适合的形状快 15–25 %（codeimpl 0.663×、15 对里 13 对更快；shellpipeline 0.749×）；debugfix 1.032×、perfrefactor 1.009× 则收不回提醒成本。
